class: REVIEW, never measurement (SPEC 3.16 (1)). Nothing in this file may enter a gate, the screen or results/baselines.json. The deterministic matcher remains the sole judge of screen and G1e numbers; screen v2 verdicts are not re-scored; the prereg bars do not move. These are candidates for the operator sitting of 3.16 (3)

instrument.declared_not_verified: the model is what the session declared on its first line, per the protocol's rule 1 — a returns file cannot prove which model wrote it. Price is unpinnable (subscription). 3.16 (2): the pin that is possible is mandatory, and the rest is why the output class is review

matcher_strings.note: the string every split below searched. Screen v2 re-emitted per post, its six aggregate cells per channel equal to the record's, and every drawn item's matcher verdict equal to the one the manifest recorded — the last is the row-level check the aggregate one cannot make

coverage.note: packs the operator has not run are absent, not zero. Every rate below is over the rows that came back and names its own denominator

matcher_candidates.label: review, not measurement
matcher_candidates.definition: one (item, brand_id) pair per brand. TP the matcher and the reviewer agree, FP the matcher emitted and the reviewer did not confirm, FN the reviewer named and the matcher did not. Precision over the matcher's emissions, recall over the reviewer's finds
matcher_candidates.not_a_rate: S2 and S3 are per-channel samples capped at 10, drawn for leverage and not proportionally, and one reviewer judged them. These ratios are a prompt for the sitting of 3.16 (3); the matcher's own numbers are the screen's and do not move
matcher_candidates.false_positives_not_split: raw on purpose (team-lead ruling, 2026-08-10). Splitting them would need a committed list of collisions the operator has already ruled on, and there is none — «Президент» the head of state and «варто» the ordinary word are read at the sitting, not here

fn_split.label: review, not measurement
fn_split.ruling: docs/STATUS.md, team lead, 2026-08-10: the reader splits FN deterministically. The false positives stay raw on purpose — there is no committed list of already-ruled collisions, so reading them is the sitting's prose and not this script's arithmetic
fn_split.rule: the brand's own aliases from the pinned watchlist, compiled by market_pulse.yield_screen.compile_aliases — casefolded, bounded by non-word characters — searched over the exact string the matcher read (the post's text, the caption standing in for it, or the two joined). Not a substring test

fn_matcher.asks: the name was in the string the matcher read and it did not emit the brand
fn_matcher.owner: the lexicon and the alias table

fn_image_only.asks: the name was never in that string — the reviewer read it off the image
fn_image_only.owner: the caption's coverage, not the matcher's recall

substring_would_disagree.asks: pairs a bare `in` test would have called fn_matcher and the word-boundary rule refuses. Each one is the matcher being right, and each one is a row where a count taken the loose way differs from the count above

caption_candidates.label: review, not measurement
caption_candidates.instrument_judged: gm4-nf4-base captions over their sha-matched sent images
caption_candidates.denominator: items whose caption a model wrote over images that are on disk under the sha the caption row recorded. Poll transcriptions carry no image and no model and are not in it — they would otherwise put free deterministic rows into GM4's rate

open_extraction_candidates.label: review, not measurement
open_extraction_candidates.asks: dairy / ice-cream names present that the watchlist does not carry

notes.note: Recipe post: only category words (густий грецький йогурт, фелата) -- no brand of any kind; 'фелата' is a misspelling of the cheese type feta, not a trade mark.

Nothing here; but note the substring trap -- 'ЛАБІРИНТИ ДЛЯ ДІТЕЙ' contains the tail of 'Яготинське для дітей', so a matcher keying on the 'для дітей' fragment would fire on a childrens-alphabet post.

Football poll on the VARUS channel: the retailer name is in the channel handle only, never in the post's own text, so closed-book this is [] -- a channel-level attribution would score varus-pl here wrongly.

Six pages and not one dairy or ice-cream item -- the album is juice/canned veg then pure non-food (hygiene, laundry, cleaning), so the caption's category list is complete for our purposes and the honest answer on brands is the empty one; watch the toilet paper on VARUS_channel_10587, '3-шаровий Нейчрл Преміо ТМ Диво' -- «Преміо»/'Premio' on a paper pack is a false-positive shape for premia.
Маркетопт promo listing 'кефір, улюблене морозиво' -- retailer name plus generic category words, lowercase 'улюблене морозиво' reads as an adjective, not a private label.
Recipe: 'сир', 'пармезан' are category/type words, no trade marks anywhere.
Long nutrition essay: 'грецького йогурта' generic; 'оземпіки з мунджарами' are drug names (Ozempic/Mounjaro), a pharma-brand shape that must not be read as food brands.

'Президент України' / 'указом Президента' -- head of state, not the President dairy brand; watchlist entry 'Президент' is a standing false-positive source on news channels and needs a case/context guard.

Diet advice naming milk fat percentages (1% vs 3,2%) -- category talk, no brand.

Pages 7-12 of the catalogue and not one dairy or ice-cream SKU -- spices (Любисток, Ямуна), ketchup, Pit Bull, кава Queen, kitchenware, textiles, bags, toys, pet food (Murkiss, My Pets, PreVital, OptiVital); the caption's category list covers all six pages and the empty brand row is the real answer, though the caption spells the retailer 'копіїчка' where every page logo reads 'копійочка'.

Official price monitoring: 'молоко', 'сметана 15%' as regulated basket items -- dairy-relevant, brandless by construction.
'Президент Зеленський' -- second instance of the president false-positive shape in this pack, here with a capitalised standalone 'Президент' directly before a surname.
'президент України' lowercase -- third president occurrence in the pack, none of them the brand; a case-insensitive bare-token rule fires on all three.
Same price-monitoring bulletin shape as @gorishnie_plavni1:30892 (identical молоко +1,10 / сметана +3,25 figures) -- two channels republish one source, so brandless dairy posts arrive duplicated.
